autotest: wifi: Add network_WiFi_BT_AntennaCoex b:79233533 generated a large number of "wifi doesn't work until reboot" feedback reports. The root cause was wifi not being able to initialize/calibrate because BT was holding the shared antenna hostage. Prevent this with a simple test that tests various sequences of wifi off/on mixed with bt off/on. Note that there is no graceful failure with this test - if the wifi interface is lost, shill decides to die with LOG(FATAL), following which dhcpcd also kills itself (because no shill..) and that breaks our ethernet control connection to the DUT. The fix for that situation should be tackled in chromium:698457. CQ-DEPEND=CL:1187837 BUG=b:79233533, chromium:876920 TEST=Ran this test on eve, samus, nocturne and bobba. Removed the fix (CL:1162876) on 4.4 kernel and tested that this test borks the eve DUT without the CL added. Change-Id: I127de09881462c236ad07635fc1a8b841ecdc8cb Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1187564 Commit-Ready: Kirtika Ruchandani <kirtika@chromium.org> Tested-by: Kirtika Ruchandani <kirtika@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org>

retry.py: add exponential backoff In server side autotest power_ServoV4ChargeWrapper, we would like to be able to send command to Servo v4 to control whether it is a power source or sink for the DUT. After sending the command, we would like to check that the command we send is actually effective, by querying the power role of Servo v4, and by checking the DUT power status. It usually take around 1 second for the change to take effect, so we need a retry decorator to keep querying until success or timeout. Exponential backoff in the retry decorator helps us reduce the number of times to retry, but still responds fast if Servo v4 command succeeds quickly. Thus, we are adding the option to exponentially increase delay time, while preserving the randomization. CBI: Remove field size specifier from output file name cbi-util accepts ':n' notation to specify the field size. For example, '--sku_id 0xff:4' allocates 4 byte for SKU (instead of 1 byte). Currently, sku_id passed to make_cbi is used to form an output file name: cbi_syndra_0x1BC64:4.bin Since we don't create CBI images with different field sizes for the same model, there won't be name collision. This patch removes the field size specifier from output file names: cbi_syndra_0x1BC64.bin BUG=none TEST=Verify md5 checksums of current images don't change. cros_chrome_sdk: Elim _StripGnArgs Before --gn-extra-args, Simple Chrome expected developers might modify args.gn by hand and made an effort not to overwrite that unless actual changes occurred. A side effect of this is that changes to --gn-extra-args might not trigger gn generation. Now the supported way to specify additional gn args is with --gn-extra-args, so we no longer want to ignore args that may be set manually. Developers who want to maintain their own set of gn args should either use a different output directory (i.e. other than out_$BOARD/Release) or pass --nogn-gen to cros chrome-sdk. BUG=none TEST=./cli/cros/cros_chrome_sdk_unittest and manual testing Change-Id: I9b92f2230536926604a3b11e9eb5176a67acdbc7 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1355541 Commit-Ready: Steven Bennetts <stevenjb@chromium.org> Tested-by: Steven Bennetts <stevenjb@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: James Cook <jamescook@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Dan Erat <derat@chromium.org>
